title: ECC Analyzer: Extract Trading Signal from Earnings Conference Calls using Large Language Model for Stock Performance Prediction

live_model.evidence: "all interactions with LLMs were conducted using 'GPT-4 Turbo-2024-04-09'. We set the temperature parameter to 0"; Table 1: "GPT-4-Turbo 2.198 3.187 5.059 7.959 11.824" (MSE at day 1/3/7/15/30).

prompt.location: Sec 5.2-5.3 ("assessed the capability of LLMs in directly predicting volatility performance from ECCs")
prompt.note: Exact prompt wording not confirmed printed.

claim.metric: MSE, direct volatility prediction from earnings-call transcripts (1-day horizon)

data.source: publicly available S&P 500 ECC dataset (earnings calls of 500 major companies)

notes: GPT-4-Turbo performs far worse (higher MSE) than the paper's own ECC Analyzer and even simple baselines when asked to directly predict volatility, motivating their feature-extraction approach; this is still a clean, attributable, reproducible result. n_items approximates the full 500-company dataset; the actual train/test split size was not confirmed in the excerpt reviewed.
